en: The postcard features a sepia-toned photograph of a port with a stone breakwater extending into the water, several ships and boats anchored in the harbor, and a distant view of the coastline and hills. The upper part of the card includes text in both Cyrillic and French, and a title identifying the scene as a port. Prominent red and black printed and handwritten text are present, including greeting phrases and publication details. The reverse side shows a typical divided-back layout for address and correspondence, postal markings, and an address written in a mix of Cyrillic, Latin, and French.
